summary.en: Israeli forces detained a U.S. House candidate and activists during a West Bank olive harvest, while Israeli settlers assaulted Palestinian farmers and olive trees, injuring civilians. UNICEF reported that 340 children have been killed in Gaza despite a ceasefire, and an Israeli minister called for settling the entire West Bank, with a far-right rival offered a Gaza expulsion portfolio if he quits the election. Reuters noted the detained Americans were later released and AIPAC halted endorsements and direct contributions to candidates. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker arresterte en kandidat til USAs representanthus og aktivister under en olivenhøst på Vestbredden, mens israelske bosettere angrep palestinske bønder og oliventre, og såret sivile. UNICEF rapporterte at 340 barn er drept i Gaza til tross for våpenhvile, og en israelsk minister oppfordret til å bosette hele Vestbredden, mens en høyreorientert rival tilbød et portefølje for utvisning fra Gaza dersom han trekker seg fra valget. Reuters bemerket at de arresterte amerikanerne senere ble løslatt og at AIPAC stoppet godkjennelser og direkte bidrag til kandidater. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.

Israeli security forces detained dozens of volunteer monitors near Bethlehem, including a Democratic candidate for U.S. Congress. 

They also sealed off Palestinian farmland elsewhere in the West Bank and arrested a well-known anti-settlement activist.
